simple.meaning: גַּו (gav) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the back.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across 1 Kings, Nehemiah, Ezekiel, beginning at 1 Kings 14:9. Its contexts include death, Torah, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַּו (H1458).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גַּו (gav) / H1458 is traced through 1 Kings 14:9, Nehemiah 9:26, Ezekiel 23:35 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H1458. gav [ גַּו ] noun [masculine] back — only suffix גַּוֶּ֑ךָ 1Kin 14:9 , גַּוֵּ֑ךְ Ezek 23:35 , גַּוָּם Neh 9:26 ; — always ג אַחֲרֵי ׳הִשְׁלִיךְ cast behind the back , i.e. put out of mind, ignore, reject ׳י 1Kin 14:9 ; Ezek 23:35 , and his law Neh 9:26 .

occurrences.englishText: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back;

“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.
“Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’ ”
